units: Sabb. 89ᵇ ככא דא׳ (Ar. s. v. קלד: בבא, Var., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) the tooth of the key, key-bit (Ar. ‘the key-gate’); Men. 57ᵃ; a. e.—Fig. א׳ דמטרא the key (to the store) of rain; א׳ דת״המ the key (to the gate) of resurrection.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 113a:12">Snh. 113ᵃ</cite> (Var. <he>קלידא</he>, <cite ref="M02259"><he>מפתחא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30).—Pl. <he>אַקְלִידֵי</he>, <he>אַקְלִידַיָּיא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 9:27">Targ. I Chr. IX, 27</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:9">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Denom. <cite ref="A02916"><he>אַקְלַד</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="S01253"><he>קְלַד</he></cite>.
